posts.community: India Shelter Finance Ltd: A Gem player in the affordable housing sector
posts.text: Q1FY27 result & concall- AUM up 24% to 11,284 cr, while Net income & profit grew slower. Gross & net stage 3 saw a spike YoY and hence becomes key monitorables. The co. switched disbursement realisation method & hence disbursement took a hit in the quarter. “During the quarter, the company consciously transitioned to recognizing disbursements on check realization rather than check handover. This transition is aligned with strong operational controls and the impact of same is onetime in nature.
